items.title: Foxy the Pirate
items.summary: Foxy the Pirate is one of the four original animatronics of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and a major antagonist in the Five Nights at Freddy's series.

items.title: Party Room 4
items.summary: Party Room 4 is a location in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 within the 1987 Freddy Fazbear's Pizza location.

items.title: Death Coin
items.summary: The Death Coin is an in-game object in Ultimate Custom Night.  It can be bought at the Prize Corner (CAM 07) to disable one animatronic for the night.
